summary: Iteration 2 testing of E-KERTALANGU (admin account creation + name-search activation). Backend: 28 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py covering POST /admin/users/pending, GET /activation/search, POST /activation/complete, POST /admin/users (active vs pending), delete, and regressions -> 26 passed / 2 failed (92.8%). Legacy suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py re-run -> 24 passed / 2 failed (both lockout tests, flaky, see RCA). Frontend: Playwright on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 -> admin login, admin panel (QR + pending-names + full create form + user list with Aktif / Menunggu Aktivasi badges), add 2 pending names (toast '2 nama peserta ditambahkan'), full account creation (Aktif badge, pengurus role checkbox), activation flow (1-char search returns nothing, full-name search -> select -> identity form -> activated + logged in -> /roles shows only the Peserta card), duplicate-email activation shows 'Email sudah terdaftar' toast and stays on /activate, UI delete of pending+active users, self-delete blocked toast, peserta route guard (/area/admin -> /roles, no React console error now). All flows passed. Cleanup done: only the 3 seeded accounts remain and all 3 seeded passwords verified working.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error when the identifier resolves to a PENDING account (password_hash is None). verify_password(plain, None) -> AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'encode' (server.py:208 -> :46). Reproduce: admin creates a user with an email but no password, then POST /auth/login {identifier: that email, password: 'anything'} -> 500. Must return 401 (guard `user.get('password_hash')` before verify_password). Also leaks account existence via 500 vs 401.

500 on regex metacharacters: q is injected raw into {'name': {'$regex': q}}. q='((' -> 500 (pymongo/regex compile error). Also a ReDoS/regex-injection surface on an unauthenticated public endpoint. Fix: re.escape(q).

minor.issue: Lockout key is f'{request.client.host}:{identifier}', but behind the k8s ingress request.client.host is the proxy pod IP which rotates (observed 10.211.12.130 and 10.211.11.204 for consecutive requests from the same client). The 5-attempt budget is therefore split per proxy IP, so lockout triggers unreliably (legacy tests test_login_wrong_password_401_then_lockout_429 and test_self_reset_clears_lockout failed on one run, passed on the next). Key the counter on the resolved user id (and/or X-Forwarded-For).

No de-duplication: posting the same name repeatedly creates multiple identical pending records (the 'skipped' array is always empty and unused), which produces ambiguous multiple rows in the public activation search.

Unauthenticated endpoint enumerates real member names (2-char query returns up to 20 pending names). Anyone can then complete activation for any pending name and impersonate that person. Consider adding a second factor (e.g. admin-provided DOB or a rate limit).
No Pydantic validation of email/phone format or password strength (a 1-char password is accepted server-side; the UI enforces minLength=6 only client-side).
Still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers.

design_issues.screen: Admin 'Buat Akun Baru' + Activation identity form
issues: Date of birth still uses the raw native <input type=date> (renders mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn date picker / DD-MM-YYYY for the Indonesian audience.

'Buat Akun Baru' has no explicit hint that leaving the password empty creates a pending account - the password field is marked required in the UI, so the backend's 'no password => pending' branch is unreachable from this form (only exercised via API).

action_items: CRITICAL: guard password_hash None in login() -> return 401 instead of 500 for pending accounts.
HIGH: re.escape() the activation search query before using it in $regex (currently 500 on '((').
Key login lockout on resolved user id instead of proxy client IP + identifier (ingress IP rotates, lockout is bypassable/flaky).
De-duplicate names in POST /admin/users/pending (populate the unused 'skipped' list).
Add Pydantic validation (email/phone format, min password length) to ActivationComplete and AdminCreateUser.
Consider hardening the public /activation/search (name enumeration + impersonation risk) with a rate limit or extra verification field.
Optional UI: shadcn date picker for DOB; clarify password-optional behaviour in the admin create form.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:208 `verify_password(body.password, user['password_hash'])` crashes for pending users (password_hash None) - use `ok = user and user.get('password_hash') and verify_password(...)`.
server.py:295 `{'name': {'$regex': q, '$options': 'i'}}` - unescaped user input in a regex on a public endpoint (500 + ReDoS).
server.py:202 `lock_key = f'{ip}:{ident}'` - ip is the ingress pod IP and rotates, so brute-force protection is not reliable.
admin_create_pending() builds `skipped` but never appends to it - dead code and no duplicate handling.

Verified good: public_user() strips _id/password_hash, partial unique indexes let many null email/username coexist (5 bulk pending creates OK), self-reset now requires roles == {'peserta'} (admin takeover fixed), RoleArea uses <Navigate/> (React warning gone).

Expected failures until fixed: test_iteration2.py::TestActivationSearch::test_search_regex_metachar_not_500 (500) and TestAdminCreateUser::test_pending_account_cannot_login (500). backend_test.py's two lockout tests are FLAKY because the ingress client IP rotates - clear the login_attempts collection before/after running them, and note they can lock pengurus/peserta out for 15 min which breaks later login tests. Always clean up TEST_* / 'Test Peserta *' users via DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}.
rca_of_the_issue: (1) Pending-account login 500: admin_create_user stores password_hash=None for accounts created without a password; login() passes that None straight into bcrypt.checkpw via verify_password, raising AttributeError before the status!='active' check is ever reached -> unhandled 500. (2) activation/search 500: the raw query string is used as a MongoDB $regex pattern; an unbalanced '(' is an invalid regex so the server errors out. (3) Lockout flakiness: is_locked() counts login_attempts keyed by '<request.client.host>:<identifier>'; behind the Kubernetes ingress request.client.host is the ingress pod IP, and consecutive requests from the same external client arrive from different pod IPs, splitting the 5-failure budget across keys.
